661. String Rotation Anagram Check

Problem Statement:
You are provided with a string s. You are given q queries, each describing a rotation (direction L/R and magnitude). For each query, rotate the string accordingly and record the new first character. Concatenate these characters into a string s2. At the end, check whether s2 is an anagram of the original string s. Print Yes if it is, else No.
input_spec: The first line contains the original string s. The second line contains a single integer q. The ith of the next q lines contains character d[i] denoting direction and integer r[i] denoting the magnitude.
output_spec: Print yes if ‘s2’ is anagram of s1. And no otherwise
